APPROVE

The extracted `CompareSegment` returns the same -1/1 for mixed segments, which the caller's `if (c != 0) return c;` immediately propagates, so behaviour is identical, and moving the pattern-matching branches out of the loop drops `Compare` well under 15. The new `object` parameters match the pattern-matching on `x` and `y`, so I don't expect new build warnings. I judged this from the diff alone and did not build the project or run the tests.
